NewTermsAndPrivacyPolicy.MainHeading: Updates to our Terms of Service and Privacy Policy
NewTermsAndPrivacyPolicy.ContentMarkdown:
We're updating our [Terms of Service](/terms-of-service) and [Privacy Policy](https://www.shopify.com/legal/privacy/app-users) (“Terms”), which applies to services like Shop and Shop Pay. We periodically update our Terms as our services evolve, and to address new laws and regulations. We've also made them easier to read.

The changes take effect on **November 6, 2023**. Here are some highlights:

#### Terms of Service

- Broadened the description of the services and features we offer to you and how these services work
- Addressed new compliance requirements around Shopify’s role as a platform

#### Privacy Policy

- Explained how we use your data for advertising, and provided information about your consumer rights
- Integrated the [Privacy for Customers](https://www.shopify.com/legal/privacy/customers) policy, improving transparency about how we process personal information when you interact with a merchant
- Updated language to better reflect how our products work, such as Shop
- Re-structured parts to add detail about the information Shopify collects and why, how we use it, and how we may share it

We encourage you to review the updated documents in full. By continuing to use our services after the effective date, you accept these new Terms.

The Shop Team

ShopPromisePolicies.Intro: Buy with confidence when you see the Shop Promise badge knowing you're purchasing products that are delivered fast and reliably. You’re responsible for reviewing and using this information appropriately. Policies may occasionally change, so remember to come back to this page for any updates made.
ShopPromisePolicies.IntroLinks: Learn more about [Shop Promise](https://shop.app/shop-promise) and [the claims process](https://help.shop.app/shop/delivery-tracking/shop-promise).
ShopPromisePolicies.IntroList: Shop Promise provides expected delivery dates for eligible merchants:
ShopPromisePolicies.IntroListItems:
> - The sale of goods is solely between you and the merchant.
> - Shopify is not and will not be responsible for any aspect of the products purchased.
> - Shopify is not responsible for any actions taken by merchants.
ShopPromisePolicies.Term1DescriptionHtml:
A limited guarantee is provided on eligible orders with the Shop Promise badge at no cost to the merchant or customer. If the first delivery attempt was later than the Shop Promise provided date, you may be eligible to receive $5.00 USD in Shop Cash to spend in the Shop app. It does not guarantee that the delivery will arrive by a certain date. Shop Cash has no monetary value.

To be eligible for the limited guarantee, the following limitations apply:
ShopPromisePolicies.Term1Markdown:
> - Your order was purchased using [Shop Pay](https://help.shop.app/shop/shop-pay/overview). However, if it’s your first valid claim, then Shopify will cover it regardless of your payment method.
> - Shopify must be able to verify that you purchased the qualifying order and it was delivered to a physical location within the United States. Purchases for digital goods do not qualify.
> - Your claim was made within 30 days of the first attempted delivery.  Learn more about [the claims process](https://help.shop.app/shop/delivery-tracking/shop-promise).
> - You can only submit one valid claim per Shop Promise order. For example, if you’ve ordered two items that ship separately and they both qualify for the limited guarantee, then you can only make one claim. You're not eligible for two different claims.
> - You used the email address associated with your Shop account to submit your claim request. If you don’t have a Shop account, then you’ll need to [create one](https://help.shop.app/shop/account-setup/create-shop-account).
> - Your reward is in the form of Shop Cash, which has its own [terms](https://help.shop.app/shop/shop-cash). Shop Cash expires in 180 days and can only be used in the Shop app.
> - The store’s terms and policies always apply to your purchase. Shop provides the Shop Promise guarantee as an additional service directly to shoppers in addition to what the store provides. The guarantee only covers a late first delivery attempt. If a package never arrived, or is damaged, faulty, or the wrong variant (size, color, etc.), then you should contact the store directly.
ShopPromisePolicies.Term2DescriptionHtml: There are a number of reasons why a claim may be denied, including but not limited to, the following:
ShopPromisePolicies.Term2Markdown:
> - A tracking number wasn’t provided for your order.
> - The claim was made more than 30 days after the first attempted delivery.
> - The order hasn’t been delivered yet.
> - The order was delivered to a location outside the United States.
> - The order wasn’t delivered to a physical address. Digital products don’t qualify.
> - The order already has a successful claim.
> - The order URL being submitted with a claim was incorrect.
> - The order has not been paid for using Shop Pay and you’ve previously made a successful claim.
> - There wasn't enough information to validate your claim.
> - Situations where Shopify determines or believes that the claim was made in error or by mistake, is fraudulent or otherwise doesn’t comply with the law, or determines the claim is in violation of the terms and conditions applicable to Shop Promise.
> - Situations where there is a delay in delivery caused by such events as fires, telecommunications failures, utility failures, power failures, equipment failures, labor strife, riots, war, terrorist attack, non-performance of our vendors or suppliers, acts of God, or other causes over which Shopify has no reasonable control.

ContentPolicies.MetaDescription: The Shop app helps you track, pay, and shop better. These prohibited behaviors and content apply to all formats of content, including but not limited to product reviews, photos, videos, and chat messages across the Shop app.
ContentPolicies.PolicyIntro:
The Shop app helps you track, pay, and shop better. A part of this experience is interacting with Shop Stores. When you reach out to a Shop Store, remember that there is a person receiving the message. This means that you should always be respectful and helpful in your communications.

You probably already know this, but you should refrain from disrespectful, inappropriate or hurtful words or actions. We’ve created some guidelines that you must follow. These prohibited behaviors and content apply to all formats of content, including but not limited to product reviews, photos, videos, and chat messages across the Shop app.

If you come across something that seems to go against these guidelines, report it in the Shop app or [contact Shop Support](https://shop.app/help/shop-app-help-contact). For more details, refer to our [Terms of Service](https://shop.app/terms-of-service).

You’re responsible for reviewing and using this information appropriately. Policies may occasionally change, so remember to come back to this page for any updates made.
ContentPolicies.Term1Markdown:
> - **Child exploitation**: Don’t exploit or abuse children, including but not limited to depictions of child abuse or sexual abuse, or that present children in a sexual manner.
> - **Harassment, bullying, defamation and threats**: Don’t harass, bully, defame or threaten a specific individual or group. This includes excessive profanity and content that is clearly and deliberately provocative.
> - **Hateful content**: Don’t encourage violence or hate against people based on race, ethnicity, color, national origin, religion, age, gender, sexual orientation, disability, medical condition, veteran status or other forms of discriminatory intolerance. This includes promoting or supporting organizations, platforms or people that: (i) promote or condone such hate; or (ii) threaten or condone violence to further a cause. This also includes any graphic violence against people, groups, or animal cruelty intended to be shocking or sensational or any content that glorifies violence.
> - **Illegal activities**: Content should not promote illegal activities.
> - **Regulated Goods**: Content should not promote age-restricted or regulated goods including but not limited to alcohol, tobacco, drugs, or weapons.
> - **Intellectual property**: Don’t infringe on the copyright or trademarks of others.
> - **Misrepresentation**: Be yourself. Don’t impersonate someone else, another Shop Store, or any other entity. This also means content is not artificially created via bots or similar techniques. Content shouldn’t be fake, misleading, or contain deliberately inaccurate information.
> - **Personal information**: Don’t disclose personal or private information, or ask others to do so. This includes email addresses, phone numbers, and credit card details.
> - **Self-harm**: Content shouldn't promote self-harm.
> - **Animal Harm or Abuse**: Content depicting animal harm or abuse are prohibited.
> - **Sexually explicit content**: Don’t depict pornographic acts or fetishes intended to be sexually gratifying. This includes any content that is sexually suggestive or intended to arouse.
> - **Spam**: Don’t send unsolicited commercial messaging or repetitive messaging for advertising or solicitation purposes.
> - **Terrorist organizations**: Don’t show support of, or funding of, or membership in, a terrorist organization.
> - **Fraud or Scams**: Any content promoting fraudulent activities or scams is prohibited.
> - **Mentioning Other Brands**: Focus on your product and your customers, don’t mention other brands or businesses in your content.
> - **Privacy and Consent**: Respect the privacy of individuals and follow all applicable privacy laws.
> - **Reporting abuse**: Don’t abuse our reporting systems, or otherwise exploit tools meant to protect customers or Shop Stores.
For more details, see our [Terms of Service](https://shop.app/terms-of-service). If you see a report that violates these guidelines, please report it directly in the Shop app.

ProductReviewPolicies.MetaDescription: Shop is an iOS and Android online shopping assistant app designed to help you track, pay, and shop better.
ProductReviewPolicies.Term1Markdown:
Everyone loves reviews - they're an essential part of the decision-making process when shopping. We encourage you to share your reviews, whether favorable or unfavorable, to express your individual experience and share helpful information for other shoppers. Shop takes certain steps to help ensure that reviews on Shop remain a reliable and trustworthy source of customer feedback.
All Reviews and any replies created by a Shop Store, must comply with the policies below:
  > - Abide by our [prohibited behavior and content policies](https://shop.app/content-policies).
  > - Be directly related to the product purchased or the Shop Store you are purchasing from.
  > - Not contain ads, links, or promotional content.
  > - Not be submitted by someone with a conflict of interest, including someone affiliated with the business (including friends and family of the business), or a competing business.
  > - Not be submitted in exchange for money, discounts, free products or refunds.
  > - Be unique. Only review a product once per purchase.
  > - Be authentic. This means they're not artificially created via bots or similar techniques. For more details, see our [Terms of Service](https://shop.app/terms-of-service). If you see a report that violates these guidelines, please report it directly in the Shop app.
  > - Not contain false, misleading or inaccurate information.

Shop also reserves the right to take appropriate action to moderate and remove reviews for reasons not listed above.
ProductReviewPolicies.Term2Markdown:
Shop takes certain proactive and reactive measures to promote reliable and trustworthy reviews on Shop that comply with our policies.

Shop moderates reviews submitted through the Shop app and any reviews collected via a partner app before displaying them in Shop.  Shop may reject or remove a review or take other appropriate action if a review violates these or other Shop policies, the [Shop Terms of Service](https://shop.app/terms-of-service), or otherwise violates the law. Shop will never alter or modify a review to change its meaning. Shop Stores may respond to your review, and those replies follow these same standards and moderation processes.
ProductReviewPolicies.Term3Markdown: The Shop app does not moderate or control the reviews collected & displayed outside of Shop. These reviews are subject to each Shop Stores's own terms and policies and may or may not be consistent with the reviews that appear on the Shop app. If you have any questions or concerns about reviews submitted or displayed outside of Shop, please contact the Online Store directly.
ProductReviewPolicies.Term4Markdown: Any review collected in the Shop app and displayed on an online store will include a Verified by Shop badge. This indicates the review was collected by Shop and has gone through our moderation process.
ProductReviewPolicies.Term5Heading: Where Your Reviews left in Shop app may appear
ProductReviewPolicies.Term5Markdown:
Reviews collected & displayed in the Shop app are displayed with the first name registered in your Shop app account.
The review collected in Shop is also shared with the merchant the order was placed with. A merchant may choose to display the review on their online store or other platforms where they sell their products, and use the reviews in accordance with their terms and policies.
If a user deletes their review in Shop app, the review and display name will be removed. We will also share this deletion with merchants.  You may contact the merchant with any questions on how they handle reviews.

Item1.Question: What is Shop Promise?
Item1.Answer: The Shop Promise badge signifies a product has been verified by Shopify for reliable delivery. Purchases where the Shop Promise badge appears include an estimated delivery date for when you can expect to receive your order. Purchases with the Shop Promise badge that arrive after the estimated delivery date may be eligible under our [guarantee](https://help.shop.app/shop/delivery-tracking/shop-promise). The store’s terms and policies always apply to your purchase. Shop provides a guarantee as an additional service directly to shoppers.

Item2.Question: Which orders are eligible for the guarantee?
Item2.Answer: The guarantee is only available for orders with the Shop Promise badge that are purchased using Shop Pay. However, if it’s your first valid claim under the guarantee, we’ll cover it regardless of your payment method. Learn more about our [policies and claim eligibility](https://shop.app/shop-promise-policies).

Item3.Question: What does the guarantee cover?
Item3.Answer: The guarantee applies to eligible orders with the Shop Promise badge. For eligible orders, you could receive $5.00 in Shop Cash if the first attempt to deliver your order is later than the Shop Promise expected delivery date. Shop Cash use and expiration [terms](https://help.shop.app/shop/shop-cash) apply.

Item4.Question: How do I check that my order was a Shop Promise order?
Item4.Answer:
The Shop Promise badge can be found on:

- Eligible product pages
- Checkout page on eligible orders
- Order confirmation page on a store
- In the Shop app on the Orders tab and the order page

Item5.Question: How do I make a claim?
Item5.Answer: Instructions on how to submit a claim can be found on [the Help Center](https://help.shop.app/shop/delivery-tracking/shop-promise). To register for the Shop app, you must agree to the [Shop Terms of Service](https://shop.app/terms-of-service) and acknowledge its [Privacy Policy](https://www.shopify.com/legal/privacy/app-users). Claims must be submitted within 30 days of the estimated delivery date.

Item6.Question: What is Shop Cash?
Item6.Answer: Shop Cash is a reward available to some Shop app customers with billing addresses in the United States (US). Shop Cash can only be used within the Shop app by US customers for purchases from US based merchants that accept USD. Shop Cash will expire 180 days after it is earned. Rewards are non-transferable and have no cash value. Learn more about [Shop Cash](https://help.shop.app/shop/shop-cash).

Item7.Question: Can I submit a claim on the guarantee before a package is delivered?
Item7.Answer: No, the guarantee only covers a late first delivery attempt. The guarantee does not cover packages that are lost, damaged, faulty, didn’t arrive, or incorrect. Incorrect could mean size, color, or other.

Item8.Question: Are there any circumstances where a claim will be denied?
Item8.Answer: Yes, claims can be denied for several reasons. Learn more about our [policies and claim eligibility](https://shop.app/shop-promise-policies).

Item9.Question: What is Shop Pay?
Item9.Answer: Shop Pay is a wallet that helps you check out faster by automatically filling in your saved email, payment, and shipping details. To qualify for the guarantee, your Shop Promise verified order must be made using [Shop Pay](https://help.shop.app/shop/shop-pay). Learn how to [set up Shop Pay](https://help.shop.app/shop/shop-pay-settings/setup).
